ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) central region comprising approximately 75% of visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated on the distal lateral lobes comprising approximately 25%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blob on the outer left lobe with irregular mottled margins; fragmented high-intensity white cluster on the outer right lobe; solid low-intensity black/gray mass covering the central region and extending to the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 72 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, small-amplitude irregularities along the primary span of both lobes; distinct high-frequency serrations and small notches visible on the distal 10% of the trailing edges near the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast circular pixel groups located on the extreme distal margins of both left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical linear feature of slightly higher intensity running along the central axis from the notch toward the water line; faint diagonal linear marks in the upper interior of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized irregular protrusions on the extreme edges of the fluke tips, consistent with calcified attachments or persistent scarring.
